description: "Your data choices" for the signed-in person (L24): GET /api/v1/me/consent lists every purpose with its wording, the person's choices and their history; PUT /api/v1/me/consent/:purpose turns one on or off (network.consent-choice@1); DELETE /api/v1/me/consent/:purpose/:client turns one app's purpose off. "Apps you allowed" (0.307.0): GET /api/v1/me/consent/apps lists the purposes each app was granted or refused at sign-in (network.me-consent-apps-result@1), and DELETE /api/v1/me/consent/:purpose/:client/refusal ends a refusal's 30 quiet days so that app's next sign-in asks again. Off is the default for every purpose. Only the person's own session or token reaches it.
